CLOUD_EMAIL.NAME: Email
CLOUD_EMAIL.DESCRIPTION: Sends an email through the own SMTP server of the settings, otherwise through the Automatica cloud.

BODY_TEMPLATE.NAME: Text
BODY_TEMPLATE.DESCRIPTION: Mail text, empty = the default text. Placeholders: {{NAME}}, {{VALUE}}, {{SOURCE}}, {{TIMESTAMP}}, {{DATE}}, {{TIME}} (also in the subject).
